statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-119170 is a regression in Python 3.14.10 in how the hashlib module enforces the algorithms OpenSSL allows in FIPS mode; it affects only a Python whose OpenSSL runs in FIPS mode. OpenSSL in the DockVault image cannot run in FIPS mode: the image ships no FIPS provider (/usr/lib/ossl-modules holds only legacy.so), its /etc/ssl/openssl.cnf enables none, neither the image nor its Compose files set OPENSSL_CONF or OPENSSL_MODULES, and nothing in the application enables FIPS mode, so _hashlib.get_fips_mode() returns 0 and the code with the flaw never runs. The statement is bound to Python 3.14.10 and ends when the base image moves to a Python release without the flaw. Verified for source revision __SOURCE_REVISION__.
